verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 5-minute 'onboarding' flow and provider/channel setup steps (choose provider, authenticate, set default model; connect Telegram with a bot token), suggesting some guided first-run experience, but there is no description of an integrated wizard UI that walks a user through credentials, channel selection, and defaults in one flow — other docs reference SecretRefs and config files, implying manual configuration still plays a role. missing for 10: explicit description/screenshots of a unified first-run wizard, confirmation that channels and defaults are set via the wizard (not separate manual steps), and independent/hands-on evidence of the onboarding UX.
